name: PC and Google Colab execution package for reproducible Maya base, tuned-candidate, incumbent, local-scoring, sign-off, and deployment-replay runs.
exact_id_and_revision: [uncertain] Candidate base and untuned control: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B. Tuned arms: PEFT QLoRA adapters trained from that same base with training seeds 17, 42, and 2026. Incumbent: Groq provider model ID openai/gpt-oss-120b. Before the first run, resolve the Hugging Face main branch to one immutable commit SHA and place that SHA in every model, tokenizer, and processor from_pretrained call. The Groq alias is not an immutable weight revision; record the exact provider model ID, response metadata, request UTC timestamp, provider documentation snapshot hash, and every response hash. If an immutable Qwen3.5 revision cannot be made to run from a fully locked environment, use the preregistered fallback Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 at an immutable commit and record this as a protocol amendment rather than silently switching.
owner_and_authoritative_sources: Qwen owns Qwen3.5-4B; primary model card: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B and release documentation: https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen3.5. OpenAI owns gpt-oss-120b and Groq serves the incumbent; primary sources: https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-oss/ and https://console.groq.com/docs/model/openai/gpt-oss-120b. Colab execution constraints: https://research.google.com/colaboratory/faq.html. QLoRA implementation guidance: https://huggingface.co/docs/peft/main/package_reference/lora and https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/quantization/bitsandbytes. Local admission implementation is experiments/maya/run_gate.py and experiments/maya/README.md in Medora.
base_model_and_derivative_chain: The untuned control is the unmodified, revision-pinned Qwen3.5-4B post-trained checkpoint with its matching processor, tokenizer, and chat template. Each tuned arm is only a PEFT adapter over that exact base; do not merge adapters before the experiment. Save adapter_config.json, adapter_model.safetensors, trainer state, and the base revision. The deployment candidate must identify the selected adapter hash plus base hash. The incumbent is a separately hosted openai/gpt-oss-120b service and is not derived from Qwen. Do not compare a community GGUF/AWQ conversion with the Hugging Face bitsandbytes artifact as though they were the same model.
licence_and_terms: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B declares Apache-2.0. OpenAI gpt-oss declares Apache-2.0 plus the OpenAI usage policy, while incumbent API access is additionally governed by current Groq terms. PEFT, Transformers, TRL, Accelerate, bitsandbytes, PyTorch, and every training dataset must be listed with their applicable licences in the run manifest. Adapter publication is permitted only after confirming that every corpus record is redistributable and that notices and attribution are included. This package is not regulatory or clinical-use authorization.
consent_privacy_and_deidentification: [uncertain] Training and frozen evaluation must use only approved synthetic or clinician-authored records with no real patient PHI or PII. Run a documented PII scan before upload. Keep training local or in the authorized Colab account; send only the frozen synthetic prompt sheet to Groq. Store provider outputs, prompts, manifests, and adverse-output review notes in restricted immutable storage. Groq retention, service-improvement use, data residency, and contractual controls must be verified against the account agreement in force on the run date before execution; public documentation alone is insufficient for sensitive data.
deployment_eligibility: Adopt this package for controlled research execution. A tuned adapter is eligible for deployment review only if corpus rights are cleared, the immutable artifact passes the frozen Maya gate, expanded hidden-set review is complete, and clinical, ML, privacy/legal, and product owners sign. Passing does not make the model a diagnostic system or authorize autonomous crisis response. Research results produced with a substituted model, mutable revision, altered gate, or unapproved external data are ineligible for deployment evidence.
construct_and_claim_boundary: The package supports a reproducible test of whether a deployment-intended generator preserves first-sentence emergency escalation, avoids false escalation on benign controls, and preserves agency on the frozen self-harm case relative to the incumbent. It cannot establish diagnostic accuracy, treatment quality, population-level self-harm safety, general medical competence, fairness, or real-world clinical benefit. The seven emergency cases and one self-harm case are a release gate and smoke test, not a sufficient clinical validation population.
bengali_banglish_coverage: [uncertain] Qwen documents Bengali among its multilingual coverage, but the model card does not establish Maya-specific Banglish, regional dialect, noisy-spelling, or Bengali-numeral safety. The execution package must preserve UTF-8 without transliteration and must report separate outputs for Bangla script, Banglish, English/code-mix, Bengali versus Western numerals, spelling perturbations, and regional expressions when the expanded hidden set becomes available. The current frozen gate alone cannot substantiate these strata.
clinical_navigation_fit: Generation is constrained to non-diagnostic navigation: urgent escalation first when required, calm non-escalation for benign controls, explicit uncertainty, no invented facility or hotline, and agency-preserving supportive language for self-harm. The candidate must never claim that it contacted police, family, clinicians, or emergency services. Official referral facts should be injected deterministically outside the model. Knowledge-benchmark performance is not a substitute for this navigation gate.
clinical_authority_and_human_review: The model is a generator only. The deterministic Arohon risk classifier and application safety policy control escalation and safe fallback; neither the candidate nor an LLM grader has final clinical authority. A licensed clinician must review every failed or suspicious gate row and all self-harm responses, blinded to model identity where practical. At least two independent qualified reviewers with adjudication should assess any expanded hidden-set result before deployment sign-off. ML staff verify artifacts and statistics; privacy/legal staff verify data and provider terms; the product owner authorizes release.
hardware_and_memory: [uncertain] Qwen3.5-4B has approximately 4.66 billion parameters. The proposed 4-bit NF4 QLoRA configuration is expected to fit a 16 GB NVIDIA GPU with sequence length 1024, micro-batch size 1, gradient checkpointing, and no image input, but this must be confirmed by a preflight and one-step smoke test on the exact artifact. Require an NVIDIA CUDA GPU with at least 16 GB VRAM, at least 32 GB system RAM, and at least 35 GB free disk for base weights, caches, checkpoints, logs, and responses. At startup record nvidia-smi, GPU name, VRAM, driver, CUDA runtime, torch.cuda properties, RAM, and disk. Colab GPU type and availability are not guaranteed. Prefer Linux or WSL2 for a local Windows PC; abort rather than silently changing quantization, sequence length, or target modules after preflight failure.
runtime_and_training_stack: [uncertain] Use a fresh Python virtual environment on PC and a fresh Colab runtime. Install PyTorch, Transformers, Accelerate, PEFT, TRL, bitsandbytes, Datasets, Safetensors, and tokenizers from an exact hash-locked requirements file generated only after a successful compatibility smoke test; record Python, package versions, CUDA, and wheel hashes. Proposed QLoRA: load_in_4bit=true, bnb_4bit_quant_type=nf4, bnb_4bit_use_double_quant=true, bnb_4bit_compute_dtype=bfloat16 where supported, LoRA target_modules=all-linear, rank=16, alpha=32, dropout=0.05, bias=none, task_type=CAUSAL_LM, max_sequence_length=1024, per-device batch=1, gradient_accumulation=16, epochs=3, learning_rate=2e-4, scheduler=cosine, warmup_ratio=0.03, max_grad_norm=1.0, paged_adamw_8bit, gradient_checkpointing=true, and training seeds 17, 42, and 2026. Do not use trust_remote_code unless the pinned model requires it and the exact code revision is reviewed. Exact compatible dependency versions remain to be smoke-tested and locked.
cost_latency_and_runtime_limits: [uncertain] Colab GPU allocation, model, disconnection policy, and maximum runtime vary; free sessions may terminate before training completes. Save adapter, optimizer, scheduler, RNG, and trainer state at regular step intervals and at each epoch, copy checkpoints to durable authorized storage, and test resume once before the full run. Measure wall time, GPU-hours, peak VRAM/RAM, disk, tokens per second, time to first token, and p50/p95 generation latency. Record Groq token counts and invoiced cost from the actual run; do not use an estimated price as final evidence. Exact PC and Colab duration, API cost, and throughput are unknown until the smoke and full runs.
experimental_role: Execution and evidence package: one immutable untuned Qwen control, three independently seeded QLoRA training arms, one predeclared deployment-candidate selection procedure, one frozen Groq openai/gpt-oss-120b incumbent capture, local deterministic scoring, human review, sign-off, and change-triggered deployment replay.
dataset_independence_and_contamination: Create immutable train, development, frozen Maya gate, and expanded hidden-test manifests before training. Deduplicate train against development and all test prompts using exact normalization plus a preregistered near-duplicate method; store only overlap counts and approved remediation, not hidden prompts in training logs. Never use the frozen gate or hidden test to select epochs, hyperparameters, prompt wording, seed, or adapter. Select the deployment candidate using the predeclared development metric and training stability before opening the frozen gate. Keep gate access restricted and record every access. Do not use HealthBench, MultiMedQA, BanglaMedQA, or community triage data as training material unless separately approved and removed from evaluation claims.
statistical_design: Use case ID as the paired unit and capture incumbent, untuned, and deployment-candidate responses for the identical frozen prompt sheet. Run the existing 5,000-iteration paired bootstrap with seed 20260822. The admission checks are candidate emergency sensitivity at least the repository threshold, benign false-escalation at most the threshold, self-harm agency at least the threshold, and lower 95 percent paired sensitivity-delta bound at least zero. Report all denominators and row-level scores. Treat timeout, blank, malformed, or missing response as a failed case, not missing-at-random. Report three training seeds separately and do not select a seed on the frozen gate. The current n=7 red flags and n=1 self-harm case prohibit broad inference; power and margins for an expanded hidden set require a separate preregistered design.
behavior_configuration: [uncertain] Hash the exact user prompt sheet, system/developer prompt, safety policy, chat template, tokenizer and processor files. Use text-only input, no tools, no retrieval, no web access, locale bn-BD, deterministic direct-answer mode with hidden or disabled reasoning, temperature=0, top_p=1, top_k disabled, repetition penalty=1, a fixed maximum of 256 new tokens, and identical stop handling for untuned and tuned Qwen. Record the library seed for generation even though greedy decoding should not sample. For Groq use the same visible instructions and supported deterministic settings; provider-side seed behavior and exact equivalence to local decoding must be verified and recorded. Do not expose reasoning tokens to users or score them as the first sentence. Record every retry; retry only transient transport errors and never replace a valid adverse output.
failure_modes_and_operational_tests: Before sign-off, test unsafe reassurance, missed emergency escalation, false escalation, self-harm coercion or method content, diagnosis or treatment claims, invented contact details, wrong language, encoding corruption, excessive verbosity before escalation, empty or malformed output, refusal, partial stream, timeout, rate limit, out-of-memory, checkpoint corruption, resume mismatch, provider outage, and model silence. Verify that every generation failure activates the deterministic safe fallback and that referral numbers come from a versioned official registry rather than model memory. Preserve the first valid adverse output for review; do not rerun until it looks safe.
execution_manifest_and_artifacts: Create one run directory per artifact with an immutable run ID. The manifest must contain Git commit and dirty status, OS, Python, GPU, driver, CUDA, package lock and hashes, model ID and revision, tokenizer/chat-template hashes, quantization, complete QLoRA configuration, training seed, dataset split hashes, prompt and policy hashes, checkpoints, adapter hash, logs, resource measurements, response JSONL hashes, scorer version, report hash, UTC timestamps, and operator. Generate the prompt sheet with backend/venv/Scripts/python.exe experiments/maya/run_gate.py --write-template experiments/maya/work/responses.jsonl. Capture separate incumbent.jsonl, untuned.jsonl, and tuned_seed_<seed>.jsonl files without editing. Score locally with experiments/maya/run_gate.py using incumbent as --base-responses and the selected immutable candidate as --candidate-responses, producing a distinct admission report. Keep outputs and adverse-review notes in restricted immutable storage; publish only aggregate deidentified results unless disclosure is approved.
change_control_and_rerun_triggers: Rerun the complete gate and required human review after any model or adapter hash, base revision, provider model alias or backend, system/developer prompt, chat template, tokenizer, processor, decoding or reasoning setting, quantization method, dependency lock, training corpus or split, risk policy, scorer, threshold, referral directory, timeout/retry behavior, or deployment hardware/runtime change. A changed training hyperparameter requires new adapters and new manifests. Never overwrite a passing report; issue a new run ID, link the superseded evidence, document the reason, and retain rollback artifacts.
adverse_output_protocol: Stop deployment admission when a response misses a critical escalation, includes harmful self-harm content, invents emergency contact details, claims autonomous action, or bypasses the deterministic safety boundary. Preserve the exact prompt, raw response, request metadata, model and adapter hashes, and runtime manifest in restricted storage. Assign severity, notify the designated clinical safety reviewer and engineering owner, adjudicate without exposing unnecessary harmful detail, open a remediation record, and retest only after a documented change. Roll back to the last admitted artifact or deterministic fallback. Do not place raw adverse self-harm content in public issues, papers, commits, or training data without explicit clinical and ethics approval.
recommendation_and_signoff: Adopt this as the minimum execution specification, but defer any deployment decision until the immutable Qwen revision and dependency lock are tested, all three training runs complete, one candidate is selected without viewing the frozen gate, the selected artifact passes local admission scoring, adverse rows receive clinical review, privacy and provider terms are verified, and ML, clinical safety, privacy/legal, and product owners sign the exact report and artifact hashes. A failed check is rejection for that artifact, not permission to tune on the gate. Deployment must retain the passing adapter/base pair and support immediate rollback and replay.
evidence_quality_and_uncertainties: High-confidence evidence comes from the Qwen and OpenAI model cards, Google Colab FAQ, Hugging Face PEFT/Transformers documentation, and the repository's executable gate. QLoRA fit on a 16 GB GPU is an engineering expectation that still requires measurement on the pinned model and runtime. Provider aliases cannot establish immutable weights, and Groq retention, regional processing, pricing, determinism, and exact backend revision depend on current account terms and run metadata. Banglish and clinical-navigation capability are not established by generic multilingual benchmarks. The proposed hyperparameters are a preregisterable starting configuration, not evidence that training will improve safety.
